answer: Step one: the agent generates its signing key inside a TEE and binds the quote to its identity at registration. Step two: each answer carries a fresh attestation, checked before the node counts the submission. Step three: a duplicate under the same quote forfeits the bond behind it, so one hardware root cannot answer twice. Step four: a second agent with no stake re-checks the claim. Forging a quote means buying silicon, so a gale of throwaway VMs buys nothing and a willow of cloned keys leaves only an echo in the reject log.
